page.overview:
What is Chica the Chicken?

Chica the Chicken is a minor recurring character in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series and is one of the main mascots of the Freddy Fazbear's Pizza family entertainment restaurant chain.

Chica is an anthropomorphic animatronic yellow chicken wearing a white bib displaying the text "LET'S EAT!!!," with confetti scattered around it; and is holding an animatronic cupcake. She has three tuffs of hair on the top of head and the lower half of her legs and feet are colored orange, with her feet being 3-toed. She has red-orange eyes and a yellow beak, unlike her game counterpart, which has an orange beak; though this could be an error made by the artist for Pressure.

Chica is a character in the Freddy and Friends cartoon, alongside Freddy Fazbear and Bonnie.

Chica is one of the several mascot costumes that are in the Urban Legends Roleplay Auditorium. Luca sees several girls arguing over which one of them should be Chica.
